about: EbikeRecs starter catalog (2026-11-14): e-bikes (commuter and city, cargo, folding, electric mountain bikes, road and gravel, fat-tire and moped-style) and stand-up electric scooters; owner build queue 2026-11-12, build asked 2026-11-14. One product per model and generation: frame styles, sizes, colours, battery options and build trims of one frame share an entry; a new generation is its own entry (RadRunner Plus vs RadRunner 3 Plus, Aventon Level.2 vs Level.3, Lectric XP 3.0 vs XP4, Turbo Levo vs Turbo Levo 4, Ninebot Max G30 vs Max G2). Names follow the maker's own spelling; no model years. Names and specs are read on the makers' own pages; where a maker site refused automated fetches (most Shopify stores, specialized.com, orbea.com, santacruzbicycles.com, gazellebikes.com, urbanarrow.com) they rest on search excerpts of the maker page or the maker's public product feed. Specs: shape = category, surface = type, balance = motor, core = battery, weight = as the maker states it. Blank = not confirmed. Years only where a dated maker page shows the launch.
